To: James Garcia
Cc: Karen Harris

Thank you for the quick turnaround, and for pointing us to your reinsurance accounting group. The first extract opened without trouble and is loading cleanly on our end, and we have the treaty documents in hand, so the schedule of treaties is already taking shape.

To close out the data intake for the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} review, three items are still open. First, the loss file gives paid amounts but not case reserves, and we need both to set the experience against the pricing. Second, the cession schedule does not show the inception year for two of the treaties, so please confirm those. Third, the premium records and the loss records use different treaty codes, and a simple mapping between them would let us tie the two together without guessing. Karen Harris flagged the treaty-code point yesterday, and we would rather build the reconciliation on your mapping than on ours.

None of this is urgent before next week, and we will keep the questions on this thread as they come up, a few at a time, rather than send them all at once. Once these three are settled, the treaty schedule is closed on our end and we can begin measuring the experience for Gonzalez, Campbell and Kelly.
